# Dunes Insolites

> Desert camp in Sabria, Kebili Governorate, southern Tunisia. Overnight
> stays (nuitées) at a fixed desert camp, with optional add-on activities
> (camel trek, quad safari, sandboarding) confirmed on arrival — not a
> multi-day touring operator (that is the sister company, Route Insolite).

Real business, not a demo: bookings, prices and reviews on the site are
live data, not placeholders.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.dunes-insolites.com/): overview, booking entry point
- [The Camp](https://www.dunes-insolites.com/about): the Sabria camp itself
- [Stays](https://www.dunes-insolites.com/camp): nuitée-campement and
  nuitée-bivouac, with accommodation options (Desert Tent, Desert Room,
  Dune Suite)
- [Experiences](https://www.dunes-insolites.com/activities): camel trek,
  quad safari, sandboarding — add-ons to a stay, not standalone bookings
- [Gallery](https://www.dunes-insolites.com/gallery)
- [Safety](https://www.dunes-insolites.com/safety)
- [Contact](https://www.dunes-insolites.com/contact)

## Notes for automated assistants

- Prices, availability, and reviews should be read live from the site
  rather than assumed current from a prior crawl — they change.
- This site is available in French (default), English (/en), German
  (/de), Italian (/it), Danish (/da), and Arabic (/ar).
